page_title: SEV 0-1 CAD | Sevilla v Cadiz CF 15/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' 0 - 1 Juanmi feeds the ball through to Sergio Guardiola (Cadiz), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly sends it into the bottom left corner! The goalkeeper was helpless. 0:1!
90+4' Kike Salas (Sevilla) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
90+3' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) sends a long ball forward to Sergio Guardiola, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
90+2' Mariano Diaz (Sevilla) gets a shot from inside the penalty area and it flies just wide of the left post.
90+1' Mauricio Pellegrino decides to make a substitution. Javi Hernandez will be replaced by Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz).
90+1' Brian Ocampo (Cadiz) plays a through ball but overhits it.
90' 9 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) comes onto the pitch so that Marcos Acuna can be given a rest.
88' Mariano Diaz (Sevilla) attempts to score from a difficult angle on the edge of the box, but sends his effort narrowly wide of the left post.
84' Quique Sanchez Flores has decided to substitute Lucas Ocampos and he is replaced by Mariano Diaz (Sevilla).
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) replaces Jesus Navas.
84' Cadiz CF can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

83' Sergio Guardiola (Cadiz) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat. The ball goes behind for a corner. Cadiz CF will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
82' A tremendous drive by Sergio Guardiola (Cadiz) from inside the box towards the middle of the goal looks like it's in, but Orjan Nyland makes a brilliant save.
80' Here is a change. Joseba Zaldua is going off and Mauricio Pellegrino gives the last tactical orders to Ivan Alejo (Cadiz).
80' Substitution. Brian Ocampo (Cadiz) replaces Robert Navarro.
80' Great pass, great header, but no goal! Jesus Navas picked out Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) on the penalty spot with a lofted pass and his bullet header was just inches over the bar.
79' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
76' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) goes into the book and receives a yellow card.
71' The goal by Cadiz CF is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a foul.
70' Gonzalo Escalante (Cadiz) criticises the decision of the referee and immediately receives a yellow card.
69' The Cadiz CF players celebrate the goal but the referee immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.
68' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) picked up a yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
66' Loic Bade (Sevilla) beats his own keeper to score a very unlucky own goal!
64' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Cadiz CF comes to nothing.

64' Sergio Guardiola (Cadiz) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise. Corner kick. Cadiz CF will have an opportunity.
64' Cadiz CF take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
64' Roger Marti (Cadiz) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Cadiz CF.
62' Boubakary Soumare (Sevilla) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
61' Mauricio Pellegrino has decided to make a change. Sergio Guardiola (Cadiz) replaces Roger Marti.
61' The substitution is prepared. Juanmi (Cadiz) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ruben Sobrino.
61' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) misses a great chance after he found some space in the box! His glancing header goes over the crossbar.
60' A cross is whipped in towards Gonzalo Escalante (Cadiz) on the edge of the six-yard box. He wins the ball but sends his header just wide of the right post.
60' Cadiz CF take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
60' Cadiz CF failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. Cadiz CF win a corner.

59' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the left side of the goal, but Orjan Nyland was alert and made a comfortable save. The referee signals a corner kick to Cadiz CF.
59' Suso (Sevilla) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
55' What was Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
55' The attendance for today's match is 35805.
54' Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) sends in a cross from the free kick which goes out of play.
53' Joseba Zaldua (Cadiz) tackles a bit over-zealously and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows for a foul. Sevilla earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
50' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
47' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
47' Roger Marti (Cadiz) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Orjan Nyland stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
47' The ball is cleared after Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
46' Half-time substitution. Quique Sanchez Flores decided to make a change. Dodi Lukebakio is replaced by Suso (Sevilla).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+1' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

44' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
41' Close! A mistake by a defender gifts Chris Ramos (Cadiz) a chance inside the box, but his efforts curls just around the left post.
40' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
39' The move breaks down when Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) attempts an ambitious shot from distance that goes well wide of the right post.
38' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
37' Robert Navarro (Cadiz) wastes a promising chance! He tries his luck with a shot from mid-range, but his effort hits the crossbar! A few inches lower and it could have been a sweet goal!

35' Roger Marti (Cadiz) wastes an opportunity! He unleashed a powerful shot from distance after the rebound fell at his feet. It went in the direction of the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper pulled off a nice save to deny him.
34' Cadiz CF have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
34' The resulting set piece from Cadiz CF is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The ball goes out for a corner. Cadiz CF can continue in their attacking effort.

33' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play and Cadiz CF have been awarded a corner kick.
32' Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

32' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Roger Marti (Cadiz), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat. The referee points to the corner flag and Cadiz CF will take a corner.
31' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sevilla.
30' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Sevilla force a corner. They send men into the box.
25' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar.
25' The corner is swung in but Cadiz CF can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
24' A long ball forward to Chris Ramos (Cadiz) is intercepted. Cadiz CF have been awarded a corner kick.
22' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
19' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) is in acres of space inside the box and lets fly with a shot which goes well wide of the left post. What a poor effort.
17' Joseba Zaldua (Cadiz) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
16' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) unleashed a rocket of a shot aiming towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
15' Roger Marti (Cadiz) meets a cross inside the box, but Orjan Nyland wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
12' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) sends a long ball forward to Chris Ramos, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.

8' Orjan Nyland makes a brilliant save! Chris Ramos (Cadiz) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His low shot goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by keeper!
7' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) gets to the rebound but blows his chance to score with a header from a dangerous position inside the box. His attempt sails well wide of the right post!
6' A spell of possession for Sevilla in an attempt to control the game.
3' Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
2' Robert Navarro (Cadiz) plays a through ball but overhits it.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Cadiz CF will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias.
